pairs.question: Fiat voluntas domini. Quae erat voluntas domini?
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question. Setup 'Fiat voluntas domini' (the apostles' words) is kept so 'voluntas domini' in the question has its referent. Dropped the preceding speech-tag narration 'Atque ita omnes aierunt:'. Answer is the single sentence answering the question; cut before the following 'Ceterum poterant et priorem domini voluntatem proposuisse...' which digresses.

pairs.question: Fiat voluntas dei. Quae ista voluntas?
pairs.answer: Utique ut pateretur pro nomine domini, non ut redimeretur.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question. Setup 'Fiat voluntas dei' (the disciples' words) is kept so the demonstrative 'ista' in 'Quae ista voluntas?' has a referent. Dropped the speech tag 'inquiunt'. Normalized initial capital of 'utique' in the answer. Answer is the single answering sentence; cut before the following 'Oportet enim, quomodo Christus animam suam posuit...' which elaborates.
